clades.title: Sentinel — security & trusted results
clades.summary: Find exposed credentials and verify authoritative analysis without manufacturing a green result.

clades.title: Covenant — governance & provenance
clades.summary: Establish repository identity, policy documents, attribution and licensing.

clades.title: Forge — source & build hygiene
clades.summary: Control source debt, document formats, language policy and task-runner syntax.

clades.title: Schema — manifests & contracts
clades.summary: Validate structured manifests and executable contract declarations.

clades.title: Proof — languages & verification
clades.summary: Compile, test, inspect interfaces and execute proof tools where applicable.

clades.title: Bridge — ecosystem integration
clades.summary: Connect BoJ capabilities and external analysis tools to repository checks.

clades.title: Observatory — advisory signals
clades.summary: Discover useful signals without presenting warnings or heuristics as certification.

clades.title: Frontier — unfinished capabilities
clades.summary: Visible roadmap boundaries: not implemented assurance and not recommended gates.

capabilities.title: Bounded secret scanning
capabilities.summary: Redacted working-tree and history scans with checksum-pinned Gitleaks, real detector controls and Rust/shell supplements.
capabilities.limitations: Full-history default; complete ancestry required. Fast PR mode requires security-owner approval.

capabilities.title: Private-key material
capabilities.summary: Detect PEM/OpenSSH private-key material in the working tree.
capabilities.limitations: Narrow detector, not a replacement for full-history secret scanning.

capabilities.title: Vaulted token format
capabilities.summary: Enforce the estate token-wrapper representation policy.
capabilities.limitations: A format check is not proof that credentials are valid, secret or rotated.

capabilities.title: Authoritative SonarCloud receipt
capabilities.summary: Verify the newest official-app result for an exact repository and commit.
capabilities.limitations: Does not run analysis; missing/pending/skipped/API failures cannot pass. Requires checks: read and existing app coverage.

capabilities.title: Repository foundations
capabilities.summary: Check required structural documents, substance and repository-specific ownership.
capabilities.limitations: Applicability and repository policy still require review.

capabilities.title: Licensing & SPDX
capabilities.summary: Inspect licence files and estate SPDX conventions.
capabilities.limitations: Not a legal opinion or full dependency licence audit.

capabilities.title: Affirmation snapshots
capabilities.summary: Validate applicable AFFIRMATION snapshots and configured signature trust.
capabilities.limitations: Optional unless declared required; a document is not self-proving.

capabilities.title: Citation metadata
capabilities.summary: Validate core Citation File Format fields when applicable.
capabilities.limitations: Not a scholarly accuracy or citation-completeness review.

capabilities.title: Source debt & proof escapes
capabilities.summary: Find untracked debt markers and undeclared proof circumventions with source-aware rules.
capabilities.limitations: Declared trusted bases and reviewed exemptions matter; not a semantic proof.

capabilities.title: Document format policy
capabilities.summary: Enforce estate file-format conventions with named exceptions.
capabilities.limitations: Opinionated estate policy, not a general-purpose formatter.

capabilities.title: Language inventory policy
capabilities.summary: Inspect language policy and Linguist configuration.
capabilities.limitations: Static repository policy, not compiler validation.

capabilities.title: Task-runner syntax
capabilities.summary: Parse-check Justfile or Makefile recipes.
capabilities.limitations: Syntax validation does not execute or prove every recipe.

capabilities.title: DEED & K9 manifests
capabilities.summary: Use maintained format validators for manifest structure.
capabilities.limitations: Validator/source prerequisites apply; structure is not runtime correctness.

capabilities.title: Contractile declarations
capabilities.summary: Validate applicable DEED contract declarations with maintained tooling.
capabilities.limitations: Not in the default estate audit; applicability and validator prerequisites apply.

capabilities.title: Strict Rust CI
capabilities.summary: Locked check, formatting, clippy, tests, doctests, documentation and MSRV phases.
capabilities.limitations: Use the reusable workflow for toolchain setup; only applicable Rust subjects are checked.

capabilities.title: Rust deductive verification
capabilities.summary: Inspect verification claims, run planted controls and execute Creusot obligations.
capabilities.limitations: Pinned proof tooling and actual obligations required; inspect detect/theatre/prove phases.

capabilities.title: Ada/SPARK proof
capabilities.summary: Inspect SPARK projects, run planted controls and execute GNATprove.
capabilities.limitations: Requires the proof toolchain; absence is not proof success.

capabilities.title: Relational-code checks
capabilities.summary: Detect relations, require goal-level tests and run applicable relational tests.
capabilities.limitations: Interpreter prerequisites apply; impure-operator policy is configurable.

capabilities.title: Idris2 & Lean proof runner
capabilities.summary: Run applicable Idris2 project typechecks and Lean lake builds.
capabilities.limitations: Not in default audit; a present project without its tool reports not_run, not success.

capabilities.title: Idris2 ABI source policy
capabilities.summary: When abi.ipkg exists, scan selected ABI source paths for prohibited IO/unsafe patterns.
capabilities.limitations: Source-pattern check only: this action does not run the Idris2 compiler or establish formal purity.

capabilities.title: Zig adapter source policy
capabilities.summary: Scan Zig files for direct std.fs/std.io usage prohibited by estate adapter policy.
capabilities.limitations: Pattern check, not a Zig compiler invocation or proof of adapter correctness.

capabilities.title: BoJ cartridge applicability
capabilities.summary: Check cartridge presence when BoJ integration applies or is declared required.
capabilities.limitations: Does not prove a cartridge conforms to the full BoJ specification.

capabilities.title: Pons & Panic Attack
capabilities.summary: Execute pons scan and panic-attack assail with explicit unavailable-tool outcomes.
capabilities.limitations: Install both tools first; not in default audit. Missing tools are not a passing scan.

capabilities.title: Accreditations & badges
capabilities.summary: Inspect badge/accreditation conventions and report advisory signals.
capabilities.limitations: Not independent certification of the advertised accreditation.

capabilities.title: Analytics declarations
capabilities.summary: Inspect Git-Sea analytics configuration and disclaimer conventions.
capabilities.limitations: Configuration signals, not a privacy or analytics-service audit.

capabilities.title: Hosting configuration
capabilities.summary: Identify hosting targets from repository configuration.
capabilities.limitations: Live service-health reporting is simulated in the current action; no verified deployment health.

capabilities.title: Metrics & proof indicators
capabilities.summary: Extract log/source heuristics for an advisory metrics view.
capabilities.limitations: Contains simulated defaults and brittle source-count heuristics; never use its PROVEN label as proof evidence.

capabilities.title: Test & benchmark discoverability
capabilities.summary: Look for benchmark mentions and test/benchmark dashboards.
capabilities.limitations: Does not execute tests/benchmarks; metric extraction is mocked/N/A.

capabilities.title: Human trust declarations
capabilities.summary: Inspect trust.txt/humans.txt and association conventions.
capabilities.limitations: Presence is not verification of identity or trustworthiness.

capabilities.title: Web & well-known conventions
capabilities.summary: Inspect website and well-known/resource conventions.
capabilities.limitations: Advisory repository inspection, not a complete standards-conformance audit.

capabilities.title: PRAT testing placeholder
capabilities.summary: Heuristic presence/mention detection for prospective property-testing integration.
capabilities.limitations: Does not execute property tests or prove PRAT coverage; excluded from default audit.

capabilities.title: Semantic audit placeholder
capabilities.summary: Reserved integration point for future semantic analysis.
capabilities.limitations: Current action prints a success message without invoking the proposed analyser. Not assurance; excluded from default audit.
